name: openclaw-memory-alibaba-local
description: Local LanceDB long-term memory; user_memory_*, self_improving_*; DashScope-friendly defaults; table openclaw_memories_alibaba_local.

dbPath.description: LanceDB directory (default: ~/.openclaw/memory/lancedb, same as official memory-lancedb).

embedding.description: Omitted or {} → local node-llama-cpp (GGUF). If apiKey/model/baseUrl set without mode → remote.

modelPath.description: Absolute path to embedding GGUF (supports ~). Default: ~/.openclaw/embedding_model/embeddinggemma-300M-Q8_0.gguf

dimensions.description: Optional; local: inferred from GGUF if omitted. Remote: defaults to 1024 when omitted in parse.

maxToken.description: Chunk budget (char/4 approx); default 2048 local and remote when omitted in parse.

memory_duplication_conflict_process.description: When true (default), LLM decides insert vs update among similar memories; requires llm. Set false to disable.

llm.description: When LLM is required, each field can be omitted and filled from host openclaw.json: bailian apiKey/baseUrl and agents.defaults.model.primary (bailian/model → model id without prefix). Plugin values override file defaults.

enableFullContextMemory.description: When true (default), append full_context_* rows on agent_end (incremental cursor). Stored as plain text with a zero vector placeholder (no embedding); not used in vector recall.

enableSelfImprovingMemory.description: When true (default), allow self_improving_* write and recall. Set false to disable.

memoryExtractionMethod.description: regex or llm; llm needs apiKey+model (plugin llm and/or openclaw.json bailian + agents.defaults.model).

enableMemoryDecay.description: When true (default), recall uses time decay (30d half-life, exponential). Set false to disable.

memoryDecayHalfLifeDays.description: Half-life in days for exponential/linear decay (1–3650).

adminPanelMemoryTypeOptions.description: 管理端「用户记忆 / 自进化记忆 / 全文记忆」Tab 的「记忆类型」筛选项；可写 category + 中文 labelZh。省略则使用内置类别与中文名。

dbPath.label: LanceDB Path
dbPath.help: Same default as official memory-lancedb; table openclaw_memories_alibaba_local inside this directory.

embedding.mode.label: Embedding mode
embedding.mode.help: local: node-llama-cpp (GGUF, CPU). remote: OpenAI-compatible HTTP.

embedding.modelPath.label: Local GGUF path
embedding.modelPath.help: Absolute path; ~ allowed. Omit for default under ~/.openclaw/embedding_model/

embedding.maxToken.label: Max tokens per chunk (approx)
embedding.maxToken.help: Paragraphs exceeding this are split further (char length / 4).

llm.apiKey.label: LLM API Key
llm.apiKey.help: If empty, uses models.providers.bailian.apiKey from openclaw.json when LLM is required

llm.model.label: LLM Model
llm.model.help: If empty, uses agents.defaults.model.primary; bailian/name is normalized to name for Chat Completions

llm.baseUrl.label: LLM Base URL
llm.baseUrl.help: If empty, uses models.providers.bailian.baseUrl, else DashScope compatible default

memory_duplication_conflict_process.label: Conflict / Dedup (LLM)
memory_duplication_conflict_process.help: Default on: LLM decides insert vs update. Turn off to use vector-only dedup.

similarityThresholdUserMemory.label: User Memory Similarity Threshold
similarityThresholdUserMemory.help: 0–1; L2 score = 1/(1+distance), same as official memory-lancedb

enableFullContextMemory.label: Enable Full Context Memory
enableFullContextMemory.help: Default on: one row per new transcript message on agent_end (batchId + cursor). No embedding/dedup; zero-vector placeholder only. Not injected into recall.

enableSelfImprovingMemory.label: Enable Self-Improving Memory
enableSelfImprovingMemory.help: Default on: learnings / errors / feature requests. Turn off to disable.

autoRecall.label: Auto Recall
autoRecall.help: When true: inject memories before each prompt and register memory_recall / memory_store / memory_forget. When false (default): no auto recall and no those tools; agent_end capture still follows autoCapture.

enableMemoryDecay.label: Enable Memory Decay
enableMemoryDecay.help: Default on: older memories score lower on recall. Turn off for flat scores.

adminPanelMemoryTypeOptions.label: 管理端记忆类型筛选项
adminPanelMemoryTypeOptions.help: 可选。按 Tab 配置 { user|self|full: [{ category, labelZh }] }；category 须为该 Tab 合法类别，labelZh 为下拉展示中文。不写则用内置列表与中文名。
